concept.hr: Predmemorija je posuđena, ne izgubljena; zapisano čeka na disk
concept.en: Page cache is lent, not lost; what you write waits for the disk

summary.hr: Čitaj i piši datoteke i gledaj free i /proc/meminfo: slobodno pada, raspoloživo ne; prljave stranice idu na disk nakon 30 s, a nestanak struje ih briše.
summary.en: Read and write files and watch free and /proc/meminfo: free falls, available does not; dirty pages reach the disk after 30 s, and a power loss wipes them.

title.en: drop_caches: free rises, available does not

concept.hr: Predmemorija stranica nije izgubljena memorija, samo posuđena
concept.en: The page cache is not lost memory, only lent

title.en: A finished write is not on the disk

concept.hr: Prljave stranice nestaju sa strujom; sync ih spašava
concept.en: Dirty pages go with the power; sync saves them
